+import os
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib
+
+matplotlib.use("Agg")
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = "out"
+os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+con = duckdb.connect()
+source = "data/crashes.parquet"
+
+# Full calendar years avoid mixing partial 2012 and 2026 records into the
+# time-of-day outcome comparisons.
+base = con.execute(
+    f"""
+    SELECT crash_time,
+           number_of_persons_injured AS injured,
+           number_of_persons_killed AS killed,
+           CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM crash_time) >= 20
+                  OR EXTRACT(HOUR FROM crash_time) < 6
+                THEN 'Night' ELSE 'Day' END AS period
+    FROM read_parquet('{source}')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    """
+).df()
+
+# Option 1: distribution of all timed crash records by hour.
+hourly = (
+    base.assign(hour=base.crash_time.map(lambda t: t.hour))
+    .groupby("hour", as_index=False)
+    .size()
+    .rename(columns={"size": "crash_count"})
+)
+hourly["share_of_crashes_pct"] = hourly.crash_count / hourly.crash_count.sum() * 100
+hourly.to_csv(f"{OUT}/values_1.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.2, 5.4))
+labels = [f"{h % 12 or 12}{'a' if h < 12 else 'p'}" for h in hourly.hour]
+ax.bar(hourly.hour, hourly.share_of_crashes_pct, color="#356b8c", width=0.78)
+ax.set_xticks(range(24), labels, rotation=0)
+ax.set_xlabel("Hour of crash (local clock time)")
+ax.set_ylabel("Share of reported crashes (%)")
+ax.set_title("NYC crash records by hour of day")
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
+ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+fig.text(

import os

import duckdb
import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


OUT = "out"
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
con = duckdb.connect()
source = "data/crashes.parquet"

# Full calendar years avoid mixing partial 2012 and 2026 records into the
# time-of-day outcome comparisons.
base = con.execute(
    f"""
    SELECT crash_time,
           number_of_persons_injured AS injured,
           number_of_persons_killed AS killed,
           CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM crash_time) >= 20
                  OR EXTRACT(HOUR FROM crash_time) < 6
                THEN 'Night' ELSE 'Day' END AS period
    FROM read_parquet('{source}')
    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    """
).df()

# Option 1: distribution of all timed crash records by hour.
hourly = (
    base.assign(hour=base.crash_time.map(lambda t: t.hour))
    .groupby("hour", as_index=False)
    .size()
    .rename(columns={"size": "crash_count"})
)
hourly["share_of_crashes_pct"] = hourly.crash_count / hourly.crash_count.sum() * 100
hourly.to_csv(f"{OUT}/values_1.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.2, 5.4))
labels = [f"{h % 12 or 12}{'a' if h < 12 else 'p'}" for h in hourly.hour]
ax.bar(hourly.hour, hourly.share_of_crashes_pct, color="#356b8c", width=0.78)
ax.set_xticks(range(24), labels, rotation=0)
ax.set_xlabel("Hour of crash (local clock time)")
ax.set_ylabel("Share of reported crashes (%)")
ax.set_title("NYC crash records by hour of day")
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
fig.text(
    0.01,
    0.01,
    "NYC police-reported crashes, 2013–2025. Distribution of crashes, not a risk rate; traffic exposure is unavailable.",
    fontsize=8,
    color="#444444",
)
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.04, 1, 1))
fig.savefig(f"{OUT}/option_1.png", dpi=180)
plt.close(fig)

# For the outcome measures, require both fields so missing deaths are not
# interpreted as zero. The complete-case denominator is included in the CSV.
complete = base.dropna(subset=["injured", "killed"]).copy()
complete["injured"] = complete.injured.astype(int)
complete["killed"] = complete.killed.astype(int)
complete["severity"] = np.select(
    [complete.killed > 0, complete.injured > 0],
    ["Fatal crash", "Nonfatal injury crash"],
    default="No reported casualty",
)
period_order = ["Day", "Night"]
severity_order = ["No reported casualty", "Nonfatal injury crash", "Fatal crash"]
denom = complete.groupby("period").size().reindex(period_order)
severity_counts = (
    complete.groupby(["period", "severity"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    .reindex(index=period_order, columns=severity_order, fill_value=0)
)
severity_rows = []
for period in period_order:
    for severity in severity_order:
        severity_rows.append(
            {
                "period": period,
                "severity": severity,
                "crashes": int(severity_counts.loc[period, severity]),
                "complete_case_crashes": int(denom.loc[period]),
                "share_pct": severity_counts.loc[period, severity] / denom.loc[period] * 100,
            }
        )
severity_values = pd.DataFrame(severity_rows)
severity_values.to_csv(f"{OUT}/values_2.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 5.2))
colors = ["#d9e2e8", "#e6a64a", "#a73835"]
for severity, color in zip(severity_order, colors):
    vals = np.array([severity_values.query("period == @p and severity == @severity").share_pct.iloc[0] for p in period_order])
    ax.bar(period_order, vals, bottom=bottom, label=severity, color=color, width=0.55)
    bottom += vals
ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax.set_ylabel("Share of crashes (%)")
ax.set_title("Crash outcome mix: day vs night")
ax.legend(frameon=False, loc="upper left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 1))
ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
fig.text(
    0.01,
    0.01,
    "Day 6am–7:59pm; night 8pm–5:59am. Complete injury/death records, 2013–2025; not risk per trip.",
    fontsize=8,
    color="#444444",
)
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.04, 0.82, 1))
fig.savefig(f"{OUT}/option_2.png", dpi=180)
plt.close(fig)

# Option 3: number of people injured or killed per 100 complete-case crashes.
casualties = (
    complete.groupby("period")
    .agg(
        complete_case_crashes=("injured", "size"),
        people_injured=("injured", "sum"),
        people_killed=("killed", "sum"),
    )
    .reindex(period_order)
    .reset_index()
)
casualties["people_injured_or_killed"] = casualties.people_injured + casualties.people_killed
casualties["casualties_per_100_crashes"] = (
    casualties.people_injured_or_killed / casualties.complete_case_crashes * 100
)
casualties.to_csv(f"{OUT}/values_3.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 5.2))
bars = ax.bar(
    casualties.period,
    casualties.casualties_per_100_crashes,
    color=["#7b9e87", "#b65349"],
    width=0.55,
)
ax.bar_label(bars, fmt="%.1f", padding=4)
ax.set_ylabel("People injured or killed per 100 crashes")
ax.set_title("Reported casualties per crash: day vs night")
ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
fig.text(
    0.01,
    0.01,
    "Day 6am–7:59pm; night 8pm–5:59am. Complete injury/death records, 2013–2025; not risk per trip.",
    fontsize=8,
    color="#444444",
)
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.04, 1, 1))
fig.savefig(f"{OUT}/option_3.png", dpi=180)
plt.close(fig)

print("Hourly totals:")
print(hourly.to_string(index=False))
print("\nSeverity composition:")
print(severity_values.to_string(index=False))
print("\nCasualty rates:")
print(casualties.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nComplete-case exclusions: {len(base) - len(complete)} of {len(base)} records")
